summary_zh: 之后又按正常面试题的写法重写了题干（中英文页都用英文题干），数字和条件不变。

issues.problem_zh: 原题干是一大段长句，把条件、规模、范围和要讨论的话题全挤在一起，读起来不像面试官会说的话；中文版又是逐句硬翻。
issues.change_zh: 按正常面试题的写法重写题干：先一句话说要设计什么，再分块列出已有条件、需求和规模、要交付什么、面试官会追问的话题和不考的范围。所有数字和条件不变，参考解答没有改。按用户要求，中文页的题干也直接用英文。

checked: read README.zh.md and README.md in full and compared them paragraph by paragraph (same numbers, code block identical, mermaid edges identical)
ran page (1 block, both languages pass)

recomputed every estimate in my own script (tools/out/scratch/b21/t2_slack.py): 210M messages/day, 2,431 and 12,153 messages/s, 900,000 online users, 1.17M connections, 78 -> 90 gateways, 2.7 online members and 3.51 deliveries per message, 11,181 messages/s in small channels, 39,244 deliveries/s, 40,000-member channel: 6,000 online, 7,800 frames per post, 39,000/s at 5 posts/s, 37.8 GB/day, 13.8 TB/year, 41.4 TB/year replicated
